title: [ FEATURE REQUEST ] Folder View - Show Global Menu on desktop
line: With the Global Menu widget in a panel, clicking the desktop now shows File, Edit and View menus for the desktop's files instead of an empty bar.
explanation: The Global Menu only looks at task windows, and the desktop is not a task, so when the desktop had focus the bar was empty. Folder View also never offered a menu: the usual way (Qt exporting a menu bar over D-Bus) can't work in plasmashell, because Qt checks once for the global menu registrar and plasmashell does that before its own Global Menu widget makes the registrar appear. Folder View now builds File (Create New, Rename, Move to Trash, Delete, Empty Trash), Edit (Undo, Cut, Copy, Paste) and View (the Icons options plus Refresh) menus from its existing actions and publishes them as the containment's "applicationMenu" internal action. The Global Menu widget, which runs in the same process, shows that menu while a desktop containment window has focus and no task is active; Cut, Copy, Rename, Move to Trash and Delete are now disabled when nothing is selected.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: provide File, Edit and View menus for Global Menu

Folder View had no menu to show in the Global Menu. Offer File, Edit and
View menus made of its existing actions as the "applicationMenu" action,
and disable the actions that need a selection when nothing is selected.

BUG: 520074

applets/appmenu: show the desktop's menu while it has focus

The desktop is not a task, so the Global Menu was empty whenever it had
focus. When the focused window is a desktop containment that provides an
"applicationMenu" internal action, show the menu of that action instead.

BUG: 520074

media.caption: Pure master: Global Menu in a top panel, desktop clicked (Dolphin inactive): the bar is empty
With the fix, same steps: the bar shows the desktop's File, Edit and View menus
File > Create New opens the usual new-file menu; Folder… created a folder on the desktop
Edit with a desktop icon selected: Undo: Create Folder, Cut and Copy enabled
View holds the desktop's Icons options (Sort By, Icon Size, Arrange…) and Refresh Desktop
